The '''Naalol system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Its [[Planet/Legends|planets]] included [[Naalol/Legends|Naalol]] and two other uninhabited planets, both in orbits extremely close to its [[Star/Legends|star]].
